The Economist’s polling tracker, which uses data from YouGov surveys, reported in June that Trump had become the most unpopular president ever in the poll with a net approval rating of negative 25 percentage points.

YouGov’s most recent survey results follow a broader decline in the president’s job approval ratings. [...] The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved.
